The permissions granted to the fine-grained access token.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actions|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for GitHub Actions workflows, workflow runs, and artifacts.|
|administration|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for repository creation, deletion, settings, teams, and collaborators creation.|
|artifact_metadata|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to create and retrieve build artifact metadata records.|
|attestations|string|false|none|The level of permission to create and retrieve the access token for repository attestations.|
|checks|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for checks on code.|
|code_quality|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage code quality data.|
|codespaces|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to create, edit, delete, and list Codespaces.|
|contents|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for repository contents, commits, branches, downloads, releases, and merges.|
|dependabot_secrets|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage Dependabot secrets.|
|deployments|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for deployments and deployment statuses.|
|discussions|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for discussions and related comments and labels.|
|environments|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for managing repository environments.|
|issues|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for issues and related comments, assignees, labels, and milestones.|
|merge_queues|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage the merge queues for a repository.|
|metadata|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to search repositories, list collaborators, and access repository metadata.|
|packages|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for packages published to GitHub Packages.|
|pages|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to retrieve Pages statuses, configuration, and builds, as well as create new builds.|
|pull_requests|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for pull requests and related comments, assignees, labels, milestones, and merges.|
|repository_custom_properties|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and edit custom properties for a repository, when allowed by the property.|
|repository_hooks|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage the post-receive hooks for a repository.|
|repository_projects|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage repository projects, columns, and cards.|
|secret_scanning_alerts|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage secret scanning alerts.|
|secrets|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage repository secrets.|
|security_events|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage security events like code scanning alerts.|
|single_file|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage just a single file.|
|statuses|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for commit statuses.|
|vulnerability_alerts|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage Dependabot alerts.|
|workflows|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to update GitHub Actions workflow files.|
|custom_properties_for_organizations|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and edit custom properties for an organization, when allowed by the property.|
|members|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for organization teams and members.|
|organization_administration|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage access to an organization.|
|organization_custom_roles|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for custom repository roles management.|
|organization_custom_org_roles|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for custom organization roles management.|
|organization_custom_properties|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for repository custom properties management at the organization level.|
|organization_copilot_seat_management|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for managing access to GitHub Copilot for members of an organization with a Copilot Business subscription. This property is in public preview and is subject to change.|
|organization_copilot_agent_settings|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage Copilot cloud agent settings for an organization.|
|organization_copilot_requests|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to make Copilot requests billed to the organization where the app is installed. This property is in public preview and is subject to change.|
|organization_external_properties_for_repos|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for managing external custom properties for repositories in an organization.|
|organization_announcement_banners|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage announcement banners for an organization.|
|organization_events|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view events triggered by an activity in an organization.|
|organization_hooks|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage the post-receive hooks for an organization.|
|organization_personal_access_tokens|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for viewing and managing fine-grained personal access token requests to an organization.|
|organization_personal_access_token_requests|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for viewing and managing fine-grained personal access tokens that have been approved by an organization.|
|organization_plan|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for viewing an organization's plan.|
|organization_projects|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage organization projects and projects public preview (where available).|
|organization_packages|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for organization packages published to GitHub Packages.|
|organization_secrets|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage organization secrets.|
|organization_self_hosted_runners|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage GitHub Actions self-hosted runners available to an organization.|
|organization_user_blocking|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage users blocked by the organization.|
|email_addresses|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage the email addresses belonging to a user.|
|followers|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage the followers belonging to a user.|
|git_ssh_keys|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage git SSH keys.|
|gpg_keys|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage GPG keys belonging to a user.|
|interaction_limits|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to view and manage interaction limits on a repository.|
|profile|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to manage the profile settings belonging to a user.|
|starring|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token to list and manage repositories a user is starring.|
|enterprise_custom_properties_for_organizations|string|false|none|The level of permission to grant the access token for organization custom properties management at the enterprise level.|

```json
{
  "key": "contributor_covenant",
  "name": "Contributor Covenant",
  "url": "https://api.github.com/codes_of_conduct/contributor_covenant",
  "body": "# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct\n\n## Our Pledge\n\nIn the interest of fostering an open and welcoming environment, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to making participation in our project and our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.\n\n## Our Standards\n\nExamples of behavior that contributes to creating a positive environment include:\n\n* Using welcoming and inclusive language\n* Being respectful of differing viewpoints and experiences\n* Gracefully accepting constructive criticism\n* Focusing on what is best for the community\n* Showing empathy towards other community members\n\nExamples of unacceptable behavior by participants include:\n\n* The use of sexualized language or imagery and unwelcome sexual attention or advances\n* Trolling, insulting/derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks\n* Public or private harassment\n* Publishing others' private information, such as a physical or electronic address, without explicit permission\n* Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting\n\n## Our Responsibilities\n\nProject maintainers are responsible for clarifying the standards of acceptable behavior and are expected to take appropriate and fair corrective action in response\n                  to any instances of unacceptable behavior.\n\nProject maintainers have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned to this Code of Conduct, or to ban temporarily or permanently any contributor for other behaviors that they deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.\n\n## Scope\n\nThis Code of Conduct applies both within project spaces and in public spaces when an individual is representing the project or its community. Examples of representing a project or community include using an official project e-mail address,\n                  posting via an official social media account, or acting as an appointed representative at an online or offline event. Representation of a project may be further defined and clarified by project maintainers.\n\n## Enforcement\n\nInstances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported by contacting the project team at [EMAIL]. The project team will review and investigate all complaints, and will respond in a way that it deems appropriate to the circumstances. The project team is obligated to maintain confidentiality with regard to the reporter of an incident. Further details of specific enforcement policies may be posted separately.\n\nProject maintainers who do not follow or enforce the Code of Conduct in good faith may face temporary or permanent repercussions as determined by other members of the project's leadership.\n\n## Attribution\n\nThis Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](http://contributor-covenant.org), version 1.4, available at [http://contributor-covenant.org/version/1/4](http://contributor-covenant.org/version/1/4/).\n",
  "html_url": "http://example.com"
}
```

Details for the GitHub Security Advisory.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ghsa_id|string|true|read-only|The unique GitHub Security Advisory ID assigned to the advisory.|
|cve_id|string \| null|true|read-only|The unique CVE ID assigned to the advisory.|
|summary|string|true|read-only|A short, plain text summary of the advisory.|
|description|string|true|read-only|A long-form Markdown-supported description of the advisory.|
|vulnerabilities|[[dependabot-alert-security-vulnerability](#schemadependabot-alert-security-vulnerability)]|true|read-only|Vulnerable version range information for the advisory.|
|severity|string|true|read-only|The severity of the advisory.|
|classification|string|false|read-only|The classification of the advisory.|
|cvss|object|true|read-only|Details for the advisory pertaining to the Common Vulnerability Scoring System.|
|cvss_severities|[cvss-severities](#schemacvss-severities)|false|none|none|
|epss|[security-advisory-epss](#schemasecurity-advisory-epss)|false|read-only|The EPSS scores as calculated by the [Exploit Prediction Scoring System](https://www.first.org/epss).|
|cwes|[object]|true|read-only|Details for the advisory pertaining to Common Weakness Enumeration.|
|identifiers|[object]|true|read-only|Values that identify this advisory among security information sources.|
|references|[object]|true|read-only|Links to additional advisory information.|
|published_at|string(date-time)|true|read-only|The time that the advisory was published in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|read-only|The time that the advisory was last modified in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|withdrawn_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|read-only|The time that the advisory was withdrawn in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|severity|low|
|severity|medium|
|severity|high|
|severity|critical|
|classification|general|
|classification|malware|

A Dependabot alert.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|number|[alert-number](#schemaalert-number)|true|read-only|The security alert number.|
|state|string|true|read-only|The state of the Dependabot alert.|
|dependency|object|true|read-only|Details for the vulnerable dependency.|
|security_advisory|[dependabot-alert-security-advisory](#schemadependabot-alert-security-advisory)|true|read-only|Details for the GitHub Security Advisory.|
|security_vulnerability|[dependabot-alert-security-vulnerability](#schemadependabot-alert-security-vulnerability)|true|read-only|Details pertaining to one vulnerable version range for the advisory.|
|url|[alert-url](#schemaalert-url)|true|read-only|The REST API URL of the alert resource.|
|html_url|[alert-html-url](#schemaalert-html-url)|true|read-only|The GitHub URL of the alert resource.|
|created_at|[alert-created-at](#schemaalert-created-at)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was created in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|updated_at|[alert-updated-at](#schemaalert-updated-at)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was last updated in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|dismissed_at|[alert-dismissed-at](#schemaalert-dismissed-at)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was dismissed in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|dismissed_by|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|none|
|dismissed_reason|string \| null|true|none|The reason that the alert was dismissed.|
|dismissed_comment|string \| null|true|none|An optional comment associated with the alert's dismissal.|
|fixed_at|[alert-fixed-at](#schemaalert-fixed-at)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was no longer detected and was considered fixed in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|auto_dismissed_at|[alert-auto-dismissed-at](#schemaalert-auto-dismissed-at)|false|read-only|The time that the alert was auto-dismissed in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|dismissal_request|[dependabot-alert-dismissal-request-simple](#schemadependabot-alert-dismissal-request-simple)|false|none|Information about an active dismissal request for this Dependabot alert.|
|assignees|[[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)]|false|read-only|The users assigned to this alert.|
|reachability|object|false|read-only|The reachability result for the vulnerability that triggered the alert, indicating whether a<br>vulnerable function is reachable from the repository's own code.<br>|
|repository|[simple-repository](#schemasimple-repository)|true|none|A GitHub repository.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|auto_dismissed|
|state|dismissed|
|state|fixed|
|state|open|
|dismissed_reason|fix_started|
|dismissed_reason|inaccurate|
|dismissed_reason|no_bandwidth|
|dismissed_reason|not_used|
|dismissed_reason|tolerable_risk|
|dismissed_reason|null|

Color-coded labels help you categorize and filter your issues (just like labels in Gmail).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|Unique identifier for the label.|
|node_id|string|true|none|none|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|URL for the label|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the label.|
|description|string \| null|true|none|Optional description of the label, such as its purpose.|
|color|string|true|none|6-character hex code, without the leading #, identifying the color|
|default|boolean|true|none|Whether this label comes by default in a new repository.|
|archived_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp indicating when the label was archived, or `null` if it has not been archived.|
|archived_by|null|true|none|The user who archived the label, or `null` if it has not been archived.|

|budget_product_sku|string|true|none|A single product or sku to apply the budget to.|
|budget_alerting|object|true|none|none|
|expires_at|string(date)|false|none|The date the budget will expire in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Only dates in the future are accepted.<br>If not provided, the budget will not expire.<br><br>Only supported for budgets with `budget_scope` of `user`|

```json

  "workflow_path": {
    "include": [
      "string"
    ],
    "exclude": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

Parameters for an Actions policy workflow path condition. Omitting `workflow_path` when creating
a policy targets all workflows without storing an explicit condition. Omitting it when updating a
policy preserves the existing workflow targeting. For new or changed workflow conditions, the API
requires at least one included or excluded pattern. This is validated server-side rather than by
this schema, which can also describe existing stored conditions.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|security_severity_level|string \| null|false|none|The security severity of the alert.|
|description|string|false|none|A short description of the rule used to detect the alert.|
|full_description|string|false|none|A description of the rule used to detect the alert.|
|tags|[string]|false|none|A set of tags applicable for the rule.|
|help|string \| null|false|none|Detailed documentation for the rule as GitHub Flavored Markdown.|
|help_uri|string \| null|false|none|A link to the documentation for the rule used to detect the alert.|

Used to distinguish between multiple analyses for the same tool and commit, but performed on different languages or different parts of the code.|

A description of the machine powering a codespace.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the machine.|
|display_name|string|true|none|The display name of the machine includes cores, memory, and storage.|
|operating_system|string|true|none|The operating system of the machine.|
|storage_in_bytes|integer|true|none|How much storage is available to the codespace.|
|memory_in_bytes|integer|true|none|How much memory is available to the codespace.|
|cpus|integer|true|none|How many cores are available to the codespace.|
|prebuild_availability|string \| null|true|none|Whether a prebuild is currently available when creating a codespace for this machine and repository. If a branch was not specified as a ref, the default branch will be assumed. Value will be "null" if prebuilds are not supported or prebuild availability could not be determined. Value will be "none" if no prebuild is available. Latest values "ready" and "in_progress" indicate the prebuild availability status.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|prebuild_availability|none|
|prebuild_availability|ready|
|prebuild_availability|in_progress|
|prebuild_availability|null|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|id|integer(int64)|true|none|none|

|environment_id|string \| null|true|none|UUID identifying this codespace's environment.|
|owner|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
|billable_owner|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
|repository|[minimal-repository](#schemaminimal-repository)|true|none|Minimal Repository|
|machine|null \| [codespace-machine](#schemacodespace-machine)|true|none|none|
|devcontainer_path|string \| null|false|none|Path to devcontainer.json from repo root used to create Codespace.|
|prebuild|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether the codespace was created from a prebuild.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|last_used_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Last known time this codespace was started.|
|state|string|true|none|State of this codespace.|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL for this codespace.|
|git_status|object|true|none|Details about the codespace's git repository.|
|location|string|true|none|The initally assigned location of a new codespace.|
|idle_timeout_minutes|integer \| null|true|none|The number of minutes of inactivity after which this codespace will be automatically stopped.|
|web_url|string(uri)|true|none|URL to access this codespace on the web.|
|machines_url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL to access available alternate machine types for this codespace.|
|start_url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL to start this codespace.|
|stop_url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL to stop this codespace.|
|publish_url|string \| null(uri)|false|none|API URL to publish this codespace to a new repository.|
|pulls_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|API URL for the Pull Request associated with this codespace, if any.|
|recent_folders|[string]|true|none|none|
|runtime_constraints|object|false|none|none|
|pending_operation|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether or not a codespace has a pending async operation. This would mean that the codespace is temporarily unavailable. The only thing that you can do with a codespace in this state is delete it.|
|pending_operation_disabled_reason|string \| null|false|none|Text to show user when codespace is disabled by a pending operation|
|idle_timeout_notice|string \| null|false|none|Text to show user when codespace idle timeout minutes has been overriden by an organization policy|
|retention_period_minutes|integer \| null|false|none|Duration in minutes after codespace has gone idle in which it will be deleted. Must be integer minutes between 0 and 43200 (30 days).|
|retention_expires_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|When a codespace will be auto-deleted based on the "retention_period_minutes" and "last_used_at"|
|last_known_stop_notice|string \| null|false|none|The text to display to a user when a codespace has been stopped for a potentially actionable reason.|

Private registry configuration for an organization

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the private registry configuration.|
|registry_type|string|true|none|The registry type.|
|auth_type|string|false|none|The authentication type for the private registry.|
|url|string(uri)|false|none|The URL of the private registry.|
|username|string|false|none|The username to use when authenticating with the private registry.|
|replaces_base|boolean|false|none|Whether this private registry replaces the base registry (e.g., npmjs.org for npm, rubygems.org for rubygems). When `true`, Dependabot will only use this registry and will not fall back to the public registry. When `false` (default), Dependabot will use this registry for scoped packages but may fall back to the public registry for other packages.|
|visibility|string|true|none|Which type of organization repositories have access to the private registry. `selected` means only the repositories specified by `selected_repository_ids` can access the private registry.|
|selected_repository_ids|[integer]|false|none|An array of repository IDs that can access the organization private registry when `visibility` is set to `selected`.|
|tenant_id|string|false|none|The tenant ID of the Azure AD application.|
|client_id|string|false|none|The client ID of the Azure AD application.|
|aws_region|string|false|none|The AWS region.|
|account_id|string|false|none|The AWS account ID.|
|role_name|string|false|none|The AWS IAM role name.|
|domain|string|false|none|The CodeArtifact domain.|
|domain_owner|string|false|none|The CodeArtifact domain owner.|
|jfrog_oidc_provider_name|string|false|none|The JFrog OIDC provider name.|
|audience|string|false|none|The OIDC audience.|
|identity_mapping_name|string|false|none|The JFrog identity mapping name.|
|namespace|string|false|none|The Cloudsmith organization namespace.|
|service_slug|string|false|none|The Cloudsmith service account slug.|
|api_host|string|false|none|The Cloudsmith API host.|
|workload_identity_provider|string|false|none|The full resource name of the GCP Workload Identity Provider (e.g. `projects/<NUM>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/<POOL>/providers/<PROVIDER>`).|
|service_account|string|false|none|The GCP service account email to impersonate. If omitted, the federated token is used directly (direct WIF).|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|

An item belonging to a project

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|number|true|none|The unique identifier of the project item.|
|node_id|string|false|none|The node ID of the project item.|
|content|[issue](#schemaissue) \| [pull-request-simple](#schemapull-request-simple) \| [projects-v2-draft-issue](#schemaprojects-v2-draft-issue)|false|none|The content represented by the item.|
|content_type|[projects-v2-item-content-type](#schemaprojects-v2-item-content-type)|true|none|The type of content tracked in a project item|
|creator|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|A GitHub user.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The time when the item was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The time when the item was last updated.|
|archived_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The time when the item was archived.|
|project_url|string(uri)|false|none|The URL of the project this item belongs to.|
|item_url|string(uri)|false|none|The URL of the item in the project.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|content_type|Issue|
|content_type|PullRequest|
|content_type|DraftIssue|

An actor that can bypass rules in a ruleset

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actor_id|integer \| null|false|none|The ID of the actor that can bypass a ruleset. Required for `Integration`, `RepositoryRole`, `Team`, and `User` actor types. If `actor_type` is `OrganizationAdmin`, `actor_id` is ignored. If `actor_type` is `DeployKey`, this should be null. `OrganizationAdmin` is not applicable for personal repositories.|
|actor_type|string|true|none|The type of actor that can bypass a ruleset.|
|bypass_mode|string|false|none|When the specified actor can bypass the ruleset. `pull_request` means that an actor can only bypass rules on pull requests. `pull_request` is not applicable for the `DeployKey` actor type. Also, `pull_request` is only applicable to branch rulesets. When `bypass_mode` is `exempt`, rules will not be run for that actor and a bypass audit entry will not be created.|

<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorg-ruleset-conditions"></a>

<a id="tocSorg-ruleset-conditions"></a>
<a id="tocsorg-ruleset-conditions"></a>

```json
{
  "ref_name": {
    "include": [
      "string"
    ],
    "exclude": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "repository_name": {
    "include": [
      "string"
    ],
    "exclude": [
      "string"
    ],
    "protected": true
  }
}
```

Conditions for an organization ruleset.
The branch and tag rulesets conditions object should contain both `repository_name` and `ref_name` properties, or both `repository_id` and `ref_name` properties, or both `repository_property` and `ref_name` properties.
The push rulesets conditions object does not require the `ref_name` property.
For repository policy rulesets, the conditions object should only contain the `repository_name`, the `repository_id`, or the `repository_property`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|Conditions to target repositories by name and refs by name|
|ref_name|object|false|none|none|
|repository_name|object|true|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|Conditions to target repositories by id and refs by name|
|ref_name|object|false|none|none|
|repository_id|object|true|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|Conditions to target repositories by property and refs by name|
|ref_name|object|false|none|none|
|repository_property|object|true|none|none|

|*oneOf*|[repository-rule-file-path-restriction](#schemarepository-rule-file-path-restriction)|false|none|Prevent commits that include changes in specified file and folder paths from being pushed to the commit graph. This includes absolute paths that contain file names.|
|*oneOf*|[repository-rule-max-file-path-length](#schemarepository-rule-max-file-path-length)|false|none|Prevent commits that include file paths that exceed the specified character limit from being pushed to the commit graph.|

A repository security advisory.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ghsa_id|string|true|read-only|The GitHub Security Advisory ID.|
|cve_id|string \| null|true|none|The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) ID.|
|url|string(uri)|true|read-only|The API URL for the advisory.|
|html_url|string(uri)|true|read-only|The URL for the advisory.|
|summary|string|true|none|A short summary of the advisory.|
|description|string \| null|true|none|A detailed description of what the advisory entails.|
|severity|string \| null|true|none|The severity of the advisory.|
|author|null|true|read-only|The author of the advisory.|
|publisher|null|true|read-only|The publisher of the advisory.|
|identifiers|[object]|true|read-only|none|
|state|string|true|none|The state of the advisory.|
|created_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|read-only|The date and time of when the advisory was created, in ISO 8601 format.|
|updated_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|read-only|The date and time of when the advisory was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.|
|published_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|read-only|The date and time of when the advisory was published, in ISO 8601 format.|
|closed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|read-only|The date and time of when the advisory was closed, in ISO 8601 format.|
|withdrawn_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|read-only|The date and time of when the advisory was withdrawn, in ISO 8601 format.|
|submission|object \| null|true|read-only|none|
|vulnerabilities|[[repository-advisory-vulnerability](#schemarepository-advisory-vulnerability)]|true|none|none|
|cvss|object \| null|true|none|none|
|cvss_severities|[cvss-severities](#schemacvss-severities)|false|none|none|
|cwes|[object]|true|read-only|none|
|cwe_ids|[string]|true|none|A list of only the CWE IDs.|
|credits|[object]|true|none|none|
|credits_detailed|[[repository-advisory-credit](#schemarepository-advisory-credit)]|true|read-only|none|
|collaborating_users|[[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)]|true|none|A list of users that collaborate on the advisory.|
|collaborating_teams|[[team](#schemateam)]|true|none|A list of teams that collaborate on the advisory.|
|private_fork|null|true|read-only|A temporary private fork of the advisory's repository for collaborating on a fix.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|severity|critical|
|severity|high|
|severity|medium|
|severity|low|
|severity|null|
|state|published|
|state|closed|
|state|withdrawn|
|state|draft|
|state|triage|

Information of a job execution in a workflow run

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|run_url|string|true|none|none|
|run_attempt|integer|false|none|Attempt number of the associated workflow run, 1 for first attempt and higher if the workflow was re-run.|
|node_id|string|true|none|none|

|url|string|true|none|none|
|html_url|string \| null|true|none|none|
|status|string|true|none|The phase of the lifecycle that the job is currently in.|
|conclusion|string \| null|true|none|The outcome of the job.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The time that the job created, in ISO 8601 format.|
|started_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The time that the job started, in ISO 8601 format.|
|completed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The time that the job finished, in ISO 8601 format.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the job.|
|steps|[object]|false|none|Steps in this job.|
|check_run_url|string|true|none|none|
|labels|[string]|true|none|Labels for the workflow job. Specified by the "runs_on" attribute in the action's workflow file.|
|runner_id|integer \| null|true|none|The ID of the runner to which this job has been assigned. (If a runner hasn't yet been assigned, this will be null.)|
|runner_name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the runner to which this job has been assigned. (If a runner hasn't yet been assigned, this will be null.)|
|runner_group_id|integer \| null|true|none|The ID of the runner group to which this job has been assigned. (If a runner hasn't yet been assigned, this will be null.)|
|runner_group_name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the runner group to which this job has been assigned. (If a runner hasn't yet been assigned, this will be null.)|
|workflow_name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the workflow.|
|head_branch|string \| null|true|none|The name of the current branch.|

|status|in_progress|

|status|requested|

```json
{

  "include_claim_keys": [
    "string"
  ],

}
```

Actions OIDC subject customization for a repository

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|use_default|boolean|true|none|Whether to use the default template or not. If `true`, the `include_claim_keys` field is ignored.|

|use_immutable_subject|boolean|false|none|Whether the repository has opted in to the immutable OIDC subject claim format. When `true`, OIDC tokens will use a stable, repository-ID-based `sub` claim. If not set at the repository level, falls back to the organization-level setting.|
|sub_claim_prefix|string|false|none|The current `sub` claim prefix for this repository.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|The ID of the workflow run.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|The name of the workflow run.|
|node_id|string|true|none|none|
|check_suite_id|integer(int64)|false|none|The ID of the associated check suite.|
|check_suite_node_id|string|false|none|The node ID of the associated check suite.|
|head_branch|string \| null|true|none|none|
|head_sha|string|true|none|The SHA of the head commit that points to the version of the workflow being run.|
|path|string|true|none|The full path of the workflow|
|run_number|integer|true|none|The auto incrementing run number for the workflow run.|
|run_attempt|integer|false|none|Attempt number of the run, 1 for first attempt and higher if the workflow was re-run.|
|referenced_workflows|[[referenced-workflow](#schemareferenced-workflow)]|false|none|none|
|event|string|true|none|none|
|status|string \| null|true|none|none|
|conclusion|string \| null|true|none|none|
|workflow_id|integer|true|none|The ID of the parent workflow.|
|url|string|true|none|The URL to the workflow run.|
|html_url|string|true|none|none|
|pull_requests|[[pull-request-minimal](#schemapull-request-minimal)]|true|none|Pull requests that are open with a `head_sha` or `head_branch` that matches the workflow run. The returned pull requests do not necessarily indicate pull requests that triggered the run.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|actor|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|A GitHub user.|
|triggering_actor|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|A GitHub user.|
|run_started_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The start time of the latest run. Resets on re-run.|
|jobs_url|string|true|none|The URL to the jobs for the workflow run.|
|logs_url|string|true|none|The URL to download the logs for the workflow run.|
|check_suite_url|string|true|none|The URL to the associated check suite.|
|artifacts_url|string|true|none|The URL to the artifacts for the workflow run.|
|cancel_url|string|true|none|The URL to cancel the workflow run.|
|rerun_url|string|true|none|The URL to rerun the workflow run.|
|previous_attempt_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to the previous attempted run of this workflow, if one exists.|
|workflow_url|string|true|none|The URL to the workflow.|
|head_commit|null \| [simple-commit](#schemasimple-commit)|true|none|none|
|repository|[minimal-repository](#schemaminimal-repository)|true|none|Minimal Repository|
|head_repository|[minimal-repository](#schemaminimal-repository)|true|none|Minimal Repository|
|head_repository_id|integer|false|none|none|
|display_title|string|true|none|The event-specific title associated with the run or the run-name if set, or the value of `run-name` if it is set in the workflow.|

Protected Branch Pull Request Review

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|dismissal_restrictions|object|false|none|none|
|bypass_pull_request_allowances|object|false|none|Allow specific users, teams, or apps to bypass pull request requirements.|
|dismiss_stale_reviews|boolean|true|none|none|
|require_code_owner_reviews|boolean|true|none|none|
|required_approving_review_count|integer|false|none|none|
|require_last_push_approval|boolean|false|none|Whether the most recent push must be approved by someone other than the person who pushed it.|

Branch Protection

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string|false|none|none|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|none|
|required_status_checks|[protected-branch-required-status-check](#schemaprotected-branch-required-status-check)|false|none|Protected Branch Required Status Check|
|enforce_admins|[protected-branch-admin-enforced](#schemaprotected-branch-admin-enforced)|false|none|Protected Branch Admin Enforced|
|required_pull_request_reviews|[protected-branch-pull-request-review](#schemaprotected-branch-pull-request-review)|false|none|Protected Branch Pull Request Review|
|restrictions|[branch-restriction-policy](#schemabranch-restriction-policy)|false|none|Branch Restriction Policy|
|required_linear_history|object|false|none|none|
|allow_force_pushes|object|false|none|none|
|allow_deletions|object|false|none|none|
|block_creations|object|false|none|none|
|required_conversation_resolution|object|false|none|none|
|name|string|false|none|none|
|protection_url|string|false|none|none|
|required_signatures|object|false|none|none|
|lock_branch|object|false|none|Whether to set the branch as read-only. If this is true, users will not be able to push to the branch.|
|allow_fork_syncing|object|false|none|Whether users can pull changes from upstream when the branch is locked. Set to `true` to allow fork syncing. Set to `false` to prevent fork syncing.|

|block_creations|object|false|none|none|
|lock_branch|object|false|none|Whether to set the branch as read-only. If this is true, users will not be able to push to the branch.|
|allow_fork_syncing|object|false|none|Whether users can pull changes from upstream when the branch is locked. Set to `true` to allow fork syncing. Set to `false` to prevent fork syncing.|

A deployment created as the result of an Actions check run from a workflow that references an environment

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|id|integer|true|none|Unique identifier of the deployment|
|node_id|string|true|none|none|
|task|string|true|none|Parameter to specify a task to execute|
|original_environment|string|false|none|none|
|environment|string|true|none|Name for the target deployment environment.|
|description|string \| null|true|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|statuses_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|repository_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|transient_environment|boolean|false|none|Specifies if the given environment is will no longer exist at some point in the future. Default: false.|
|production_environment|boolean|false|none|Specifies if the given environment is one that end-users directly interact with. Default: false.|
|performed_via_github_app|null \| [integration](#schemaintegration)|false|none|none|

A GitHub issue linked to a code scanning alert. The issue may belong to a different repository.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|number|integer|true|none|The issue number.|
|title|string|true|none|The title of the issue.|
|state|string|true|none|The state of the issue.|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|The REST API URL of the issue.|
|html_url|string(uri)|true|none|The URL to view the issue on GitHub.|
|repository|[simple-repository](#schemasimple-repository)|true|none|A GitHub repository.|
|issue_type|[issue-type](#schemaissue-type)|true|none|The type assigned to the issue. This is only present for issues in repositories where issue types are supported.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|number|[alert-number](#schemaalert-number)|true|read-only|The security alert number.|
|created_at|[alert-created-at](#schemaalert-created-at)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was created in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|updated_at|[alert-updated-at](#schemaalert-updated-at)|false|read-only|The time that the alert was last updated in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|url|[alert-url](#schemaalert-url)|true|read-only|The REST API URL of the alert resource.|
|html_url|[alert-html-url](#schemaalert-html-url)|true|read-only|The GitHub URL of the alert resource.|
|instances_url|[alert-instances-url](#schemaalert-instances-url)|true|read-only|The REST API URL for fetching the list of instances for an alert.|
|state|[code-scanning-alert-state](#schemacode-scanning-alert-state)|true|none|State of a code scanning alert.|
|fixed_at|[alert-fixed-at](#schemaalert-fixed-at)|false|read-only|The time that the alert was no longer detected and was considered fixed in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|dismissed_by|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|none|
|dismissed_at|[alert-dismissed-at](#schemaalert-dismissed-at)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was dismissed in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|dismissed_reason|[code-scanning-alert-dismissed-reason](#schemacode-scanning-alert-dismissed-reason)|true|none|**Required when the state is dismissed.** The reason for dismissing or closing the alert.|
|dismissed_comment|[code-scanning-alert-dismissed-comment](#schemacode-scanning-alert-dismissed-comment)|false|none|The dismissal comment associated with the dismissal of the alert.|
|rule|[code-scanning-alert-rule-summary](#schemacode-scanning-alert-rule-summary)|true|none|none|
|tool|[code-scanning-analysis-tool](#schemacode-scanning-analysis-tool)|true|none|none|
|most_recent_instance|[code-scanning-alert-instance](#schemacode-scanning-alert-instance)|true|none|none|
|dismissal_approved_by|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|none|
|assignees|[[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)]|false|none|none|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|state|dismissed|
|state|fixed|
|state|null|
|dismissed_reason|false positive|
|dismissed_reason|won't fix|
|dismissed_reason|used in tests|
|dismissed_reason|mitigated|
|dismissed_reason|null|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string \| null|false|none|A unique identifier for the rule used to detect the alert.|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the rule used to detect the alert.|
|severity|string \| null|false|none|The severity of the alert.|
|security_severity_level|string \| null|false|none|The security severity of the alert.|
|description|string|false|none|A short description of the rule used to detect the alert.|
|full_description|string|false|none|A description of the rule used to detect the alert.|
|tags|[string]|false|none|A set of tags applicable for the rule.|
|help|string \| null|false|none|Detailed documentation for the rule as GitHub Flavored Markdown.|
|help_uri|string \| null|false|none|A link to the documentation for the rule used to detect the alert.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|severity|none|
|severity|note|
|severity|warning|
|severity|error|
|severity|null|
|security_severity_level|low|
|security_severity_level|medium|
|security_severity_level|high|
|security_severity_level|critical|
|security_severity_level|null|

A run of a CodeQL query against one or more repositories.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer|true|none|The ID of the variant analysis.|
|controller_repo|[simple-repository](#schemasimple-repository)|true|none|A GitHub repository.|
|actor|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
|query_language|[code-scanning-variant-analysis-language](#schemacode-scanning-variant-analysis-language)|true|none|The language targeted by the CodeQL query|
|query_pack_url|string|true|none|The download url for the query pack.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time at which the variant analysis was created, in ISO 8601 format':' YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time at which the variant analysis was last updated, in ISO 8601 format':' YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.|
|completed_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The date and time at which the variant analysis was completed, in ISO 8601 format':' YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Will be null if the variant analysis has not yet completed or this information is not available.|
|status|string|true|none|none|
|actions_workflow_run_id|integer|false|none|The GitHub Actions workflow run used to execute this variant analysis. This is only available if the workflow run has started.|
|failure_reason|string|false|none|The reason for a failure of the variant analysis. This is only available if the variant analysis has failed.|
|scanned_repositories|[object]|false|none|none|
|skipped_repositories|object|false|none|Information about repositories that were skipped from processing. This information is only available to the user that initiated the variant analysis.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|query_language|javascript|

|query_language|ruby|
|query_language|rust|
|query_language|swift|
|status|in_progress|
|status|succeeded|
|status|failed|
|status|cancelled|
|failure_reason|no_repos_queried|
|failure_reason|actions_workflow_run_failed|
|failure_reason|internal_error|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state|string|false|none|The desired state of code scanning default setup.|
|runner_type|string|false|none|Runner type to be used.|
|runner_label|string \| null|false|none|Runner label to be used if the runner type is labeled.|
|query_suite|string|false|none|CodeQL query suite to be used.|
|threat_model|string|false|none|Threat model to be used for code scanning analysis. Use `remote` to analyze only network sources and `remote_and_local` to include local sources like filesystem access, command-line arguments, database reads, environment variable and standard input.|
|languages|[string]|false|none|CodeQL languages to be analyzed.|

|Property|Value|

|state|not-configured|
|runner_type|standard|

|threat_model|remote|
|threat_model|remote_and_local|
|languages|actions|

|languages|javascript-typescript|

```json
{
  "run_id": 0,
  "run_url": "string"
}
```

You can use `run_url` to track the status of the run. This includes a property status and conclusion.
You should not rely on this always being an actions workflow run object.

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|run_id|integer|false|none|ID of the corresponding run.|
|run_url|string|false|none|URL of the corresponding run.|

<h2 id="tocS_code-scanning-analysis-sarif-file">code-scanning-analysis-sarif-file</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacode-scanning-analysis-sarif-file"></a>
<a id="schema_code-scanning-analysis-sarif-file"></a>
<a id="tocScode-scanning-analysis-sarif-file"></a>
<a id="tocscode-scanning-analysis-sarif-file"></a>

```json
"string"
```

A Base64 string representing the SARIF file to upload. You must first compress your SARIF file using [`gzip`](http://www.gnu.org/software/gzip/manual/gzip.html) and then translate the contents of the file into a Base64 encoding string. For more information, see "[SARIF support for code scanning](https://docs.github.com/code-security/secure-coding/sarif-support-for-code-scanning)."

```json
{
  "processing_status": "pending",
  "analyses_url": "http://example.com",
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|processing_status|string|false|none|`pending` files have not yet been processed, while `complete` means results from the SARIF have been stored. `failed` files have either not been processed at all, or could only be partially processed.|
|analyses_url|string \| null(uri)|false|read-only|The REST API URL for getting the analyses associated with the upload.|
|errors|[string]|false|read-only|Any errors that ocurred during processing of the delivery.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|processing_status|pending|
|processing_status|complete|
|processing_status|failed|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|custom_branch_policies|boolean|true|none|Whether only branches that match the specified name patterns can deploy to this environment.  If `custom_branch_policies` is `true`, `protected_branches` must be `false`; if `custom_branch_policies` is `false`, `protected_branches` must be `true`.|

<a id="schemadeployment-branch-policy-name-pattern-with-type"></a>
<a id="schema_deployment-branch-policy-name-pattern-with-type"></a>
<a id="tocSdeployment-branch-policy-name-pattern-with-type"></a>
<a id="tocsdeployment-branch-policy-name-pattern-with-type"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "release/*",
  "type": "branch"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name pattern that branches or tags must match in order to deploy to the environment.<br><br>Wildcard characters will not match `/`. For example, to match branches that begin with `release/` and contain an additional single slash, use `release/*/*`.<br>For more information about pattern matching syntax, see the [Ruby File.fnmatch documentation](https://ruby-doc.org/core-2.5.1/File.html#method-c-fnmatch).|
|type|string|false|none|Whether this rule targets a branch or tag|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|branch|
|type|tag|

A minimal reference to an issue linked from a timeline event (e.g. sub-issue, parent-issue, or dependency events).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|number|integer|true|none|The number of the referenced issue.|
|title|string|true|none|The title of the referenced issue.|
|state|string|true|none|The state of the referenced issue.|
|state_reason|string \| null|false|none|The reason for the referenced issue's state.|
|repository|[simple-repository](#schemasimple-repository)|true|none|A GitHub repository.|
|issue_type|object \| null|true|none|The type of the referenced issue.|

<h2 id="tocS_issue-event-intent">issue-event-intent</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissue-event-intent"></a>
<a id="schema_issue-event-intent"></a>
<a id="tocSissue-event-intent"></a>
<a id="tocsissue-event-intent"></a>

```json
{
  "rationale": "string",
  "confidence": "LOW"
}
```

The intent behind an agent's action on an issue, including the rationale and confidence. Present (and `null` when the event carried no agent intent) on supported event types while the issue suggestions feature is enabled for the repository; the property is omitted entirely when the feature is disabled or the event type does not support intent.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rationale|string \| null|false|none|The reasoning the agent provided for the change.|
|confidence|string \| null|false|none|The confidence level the agent had when performing this action.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|confidence|LOW|
|confidence|MEDIUM|
|confidence|HIGH|
|confidence|null|

<h2 id="tocS_issue-artifact">issue-artifact</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissue-artifact"></a>
<a id="schema_issue-artifact"></a>
<a id="tocSissue-artifact"></a>
<a id="tocsissue-artifact"></a>

```json
{
  "id": 42,
  "html_url": "https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World/issues/1347/artifacts/1",
  "number": 1,
  "type": "plan",
  "name": "Implementation plan",
  "body": "## Plan\n\nBuild the feature in two phases.",
  "body_html": "<h2>Plan</h2>\n<p>Build the feature in two phases.</p>",
  "description": "Build the feature in two phases.",
  "creator": {
    "login": "octocat",
    "id": 1
  },
  "updated_by_actor": {
    "login": "monalisa",
    "id": 2
  },
  "created_at": "2026-09-21T15:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-09-21T15:30:00Z"
}
```

Issue artifacts are named, typed pieces of content attached to an issue.
They give people and agents a durable place to preserve context and
supporting material alongside the work. Each artifact has a number unique
within the issue.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|The globally unique identifier of the artifact.|
|html_url|string(uri)|false|none|The canonical browser URL for the artifact in its issue context.|
|number|integer|true|none|The artifact number within the issue.|
|type|string|true|none|The artifact type. The types supported for external creation and filtering are:<br><br>- `generic` is a general-purpose Markdown document.<br>- `link` represents a named link.<br>- `plan` is a Markdown plan.<br>- `embedded_html` is a self-contained HTML document. Its `body` contains the HTML source.|
|name|string|true|none|The human-readable name of the artifact.|
|body|string|true|none|The artifact content. For `embedded_html` artifacts, this is the HTML source.|
|body_html|string \| null|true|none|The artifact content rendered as HTML, or `null` if rendering times out or is skipped<br>to protect the response's time budget. The raw content remains available in `body`.|
|description|string|true|none|A short, generated summary of the artifact.|
|creator|object \| null|true|none|The user or integration that created the artifact.|
|updated_by_actor|object \| null|true|none|The user or integration that most recently updated the artifact.|
|created_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The time the artifact was created.|
|updated_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The time the artifact was last updated.|

An agent-proposed change to an issue that a maintainer can approve or dismiss.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer|true|none|The unique identifier of the suggestion.|
|issue_id|integer|true|none|The unique identifier of the issue the suggestion applies to.|
|action|string|true|none|The kind of change proposed.|
|state|string|true|none|The suggestion's lifecycle state.|
|target_id|integer \| null|true|none|The identifier of the target the change applies to (issue type, label, field, assignee, or duplicate issue), when applicable.|
|target_value|null \| string \| number \| boolean \| array|true|none|The proposed value, when applicable. An array for multi-select field suggestions.|
|rationale|string \| null|true|none|The rationale the actor provided for the suggestion.|
|confidence|string \| null|true|none|The actor's confidence level in the suggestion.|
|actor_id|integer \| null|true|none|The unique identifier of the actor that proposed the suggestion.|
|issue_event_id|integer \| null|true|none|The identifier of the timeline event created when the suggestion was approved, when applicable.|
|resolved_by|integer \| null|true|none|The unique identifier of the user who approved or dismissed the suggestion.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The time the suggestion was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The time the suggestion was last updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|action|set_type|
|action|add_label|
|action|add_field|
|action|add_assignee|
|action|close_issue|
|state|pending|
|state|applied|
|state|approved|
|state|dismissed|
|state|replaced|
|state|invalidated|
|confidence|LOW|
|confidence|MEDIUM|
|confidence|HIGH|
|confidence|null|

Pull Request Review Comments are comments on a portion of the Pull Request's diff.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string|true|none|URL for the pull request review comment|
|pull_request_review_id|integer \| null(int64)|true|none|The ID of the pull request review to which the comment belongs.|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|The ID of the pull request review comment.|
|node_id|string|true|none|The node ID of the pull request review comment.|
|diff_hunk|string|true|none|The diff of the line that the comment refers to.|
|path|string|true|none|The relative path of the file to which the comment applies.|
|position|integer|false|none|The line index in the diff to which the comment applies. This field is closing down; use `line` instead.|
|original_position|integer|false|none|The index of the original line in the diff to which the comment applies. This field is closing down; use `original_line` instead.|
|commit_id|string|true|none|The SHA of the commit to which the comment applies.|
|original_commit_id|string|true|none|The SHA of the original commit to which the comment applies.|
|in_reply_to_id|integer|false|none|The comment ID to reply to.|
|user|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|none|
|body|string|true|none|The text of the comment.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|html_url|string(uri)|true|none|HTML URL for the pull request review comment.|
|pull_request_url|string(uri)|true|none|URL for the pull request that the review comment belongs to.|
|author_association|[author-association](#schemaauthor-association)|true|none|How the author is associated with the repository.|
|_links|object|true|none|none|
|start_line|integer \| null|false|none|The first line of the range for a multi-line comment.|
|original_start_line|integer \| null|false|none|The first line of the range for a multi-line comment.|
|start_side|string \| null|false|none|The side of the first line of the range for a multi-line comment.|
|line|integer|false|none|The line of the blob to which the comment applies. The last line of the range for a multi-line comment|
|original_line|integer|false|none|The line of the blob to which the comment applies. The last line of the range for a multi-line comment|
|side|string|false|none|The side of the diff to which the comment applies. The side of the last line of the range for a multi-line comment|
|subject_type|string|false|none|The level at which the comment is targeted, can be a diff line or a file.|
|reactions|[reaction-rollup](#schemareaction-rollup)|false|none|none|
|body_html|string|false|none|none|
|body_text|string|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|author_association|COLLABORATOR|
|author_association|CONTRIBUTOR|

|author_association|FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR|

|author_association|MEMBER|

|start_side|LEFT|

|side|LEFT|
|side|RIGHT|
|subject_type|line|
|subject_type|file|

Pull requests let you tell others about changes you've pushed to a repository on GitHub. Once a pull request is sent, interested parties can review the set of changes, discuss potential modifications, and even push follow-up commits if necessary.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|none|
|node_id|string|true|none|none|
|html_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|diff_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|patch_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|issue_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|commits_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|review_comments_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|review_comment_url|string|true|none|none|
|comments_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|statuses_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|number|integer|true|none|Number uniquely identifying the pull request within its repository.|
|state|string|true|none|State of this Pull Request. Either `open` or `closed`.|
|locked|boolean|true|none|none|
|title|string|true|none|The title of the pull request.|
|user|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
|body|string \| null|true|none|none|
|labels|[object]|true|none|none|
|milestone|null \| [milestone](#schemamilestone)|true|none|none|
|active_lock_reason|string \| null|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|closed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|none|
|merged_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|none|
|merge_commit_sha|string \| null|true|none|none|
|assignee|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|none|
|assignees|[[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)]|false|none|none|
|requested_reviewers|[[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)]|false|none|none|
|requested_teams|[[team-simple](#schemateam-simple)]|false|none|none|
|head|object|true|none|none|
|base|object|true|none|none|
|_links|object|true|none|none|
|author_association|[author-association](#schemaauthor-association)|true|none|How the author is associated with the repository.|
|auto_merge|[auto-merge](#schemaauto-merge)|true|none|The status of auto merging a pull request.|
|stack|[pull-request-stack](#schemapull-request-stack)|false|none|The stack information associated with a pull request.|
|draft|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether or not the pull request is a draft.|

|review_comments|integer|true|none|none|

|deletions|integer|true|none|none|
|changed_files|integer|true|none|none|

|resolved_by|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|none|
|resolution_comment|string \| null|false|none|An optional comment to resolve an alert.|
|secret_type|string|false|none|The type of secret that secret scanning detected.|
|secret_type_display_name|string|false|none|User-friendly name for the detected secret, matching the `secret_type`.<br>For a list of built-in patterns, see "[Supported secret scanning patterns](https://docs.github.com/code-security/secret-scanning/introduction/supported-secret-scanning-patterns#supported-secrets)."|

|provider_slug|string \| null|false|none|The slug identifier for the provider of the secret that was detected. Use this value for filtering by provider with the `providers` or `exclude_providers` parameters.|
|secret|string|false|none|The secret that was detected.|

|push_protection_bypassed_by|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|none|
|push_protection_bypassed_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The time that push protection was bypassed in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|push_protection_bypass_request_reviewer|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|none|

|push_protection_bypass_request_html_url|string \| null(uri)|false|none|The URL to a push protection bypass request.|
|validity|string|false|none|The token status as of the latest validity check.|
|publicly_leaked|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether the detected secret was publicly leaked.|
|multi_repo|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether the detected secret was found in multiple repositories under the same organization or enterprise.|
|is_base64_encoded|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value representing whether or not alert is base64 encoded|
|first_location_detected|null \| [secret-scanning-first-detected-location](#schemasecret-scanning-first-detected-location)|false|none|none|
|has_more_locations|boolean|false|none|A boolean value representing whether or not the token in the alert was detected in more than one location.|
|assigned_to|null \| [simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|false|none|none|
|closure_request_comment|string \| null|false|none|An optional comment from the closure request author.|
|closure_request_reviewer_comment|string \| null|false|none|An optional comment from the closure request reviewer.|

```json
  "status": "string",
  "completed_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "started_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

Information on a single scan performed by secret scanning on the repository

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|false|none|The type of scan|
|status|string|false|none|The state of the scan. Either "completed", "running", "pending", "failed", or "unknown".<br><br>"failed": this scan type has hit its retry limit and has been marked permanently failed.<br>This usually resolves on its own at the next scheduled scan attempt. If "failed" persists, contact Support.<br><br>"unknown": the scan is in an unrecognized or currently unhandled state.|
|completed_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The time that the scan was completed. Empty if the scan is running|
|started_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The time that the scan was started. Empty if the scan is pending|

```json
{
  "summary": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "cve_id": "string",
  "vulnerabilities": [
    {
      "package": {
        "ecosystem": "rubygems",
        "name": "string"
      },
      "vulnerable_version_range": "string",
      "patched_versions": "string",
      "vulnerable_functions": [
        "string"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "cwe_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "credits": [
    {
      "login": "string",
      "type": "analyst"
    }
  ],
  "severity": "critical",
  "cvss_vector_string": "string",
  "start_private_fork": false
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|summary|string|true|none|A short summary of the advisory.|
|description|string|true|none|A detailed description of what the advisory impacts.|
|cve_id|string \| null|false|none|The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) ID.|
|vulnerabilities|[object]|true|none|A product affected by the vulnerability detailed in a repository security advisory.|
|cwe_ids|[string]|false|none|A list of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) IDs.|
|credits|[object]|false|none|A list of users receiving credit for their participation in the security advisory.|
|severity|string \| null|false|none|The severity of the advisory. You must choose between setting this field or `cvss_vector_string`.|
|cvss_vector_string|string \| null|false|none|The CVSS vector that calculates the severity of the advisory. You must choose between setting this field or `severity`.|
|start_private_fork|boolean|false|none|Whether to create a temporary private fork of the repository to collaborate on a fix.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|severity|critical|
|severity|high|
|severity|medium|
|severity|low|
|severity|null|

<a id="tocScodespaces-user-public-key"></a>
<a id="tocscodespaces-user-public-key"></a>

```json
{
  "key_id": "1234567",
  "key": "hBT5WZEj8ZoOv6TYJsfWq7MxTEQopZO5/IT3ZCVQPzs="
}
```

The public key used for setting user Codespaces' Secrets.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key_id|string|true|none|The identifier for the key.|
|key|string|true|none|The Base64 encoded public key.|

<h2 id="tocS_codespace-export-details">codespace-export-details</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacodespace-export-details"></a>
<a id="schema_codespace-export-details"></a>
<a id="tocScodespace-export-details"></a>
<a id="tocscodespace-export-details"></a>

```json
{
  "state": "succeeded | failed | in_progress",
  "completed_at": "2021-01-01T19:01:12Z",
  "branch": "codespace-monalisa-octocat-hello-world-g4wpq6h95q",
  "sha": "fd95a81ca01e48ede9f39c799ecbcef817b8a3b2",
  "id": "latest",
  "export_url": "https://api.github.com/user/codespaces/:name/exports/latest",
  "html_url": "https://github.com/octocat/hello-world/tree/:branch"
}
```

An export of a codespace. Also, latest export details for a codespace can be fetched with id = latest

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state|string \| null|false|none|State of the latest export|
|completed_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|Completion time of the last export operation|
|branch|string \| null|false|none|Name of the exported branch|
|sha|string \| null|false|none|Git commit SHA of the exported branch|
|id|string|false|none|Id for the export details|
|export_url|string|false|none|Url for fetching export details|
|html_url|string \| null|false|none|Web url for the exported branch|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|none|
|name|string|true|none|Automatically generated name of this codespace.|
|display_name|string \| null|false|none|Display name for this codespace.|
|environment_id|string \| null|true|none|UUID identifying this codespace's environment.|
|owner|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
|billable_owner|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
|repository|[full-repository](#schemafull-repository)|true|none|Full Repository|
|machine|null \| [codespace-machine](#schemacodespace-machine)|true|none|none|
|devcontainer_path|string \| null|false|none|Path to devcontainer.json from repo root used to create Codespace.|
|prebuild|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether the codespace was created from a prebuild.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|last_used_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Last known time this codespace was started.|
|state|string|true|none|State of this codespace.|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL for this codespace.|
|git_status|object|true|none|Details about the codespace's git repository.|
|location|string|true|none|The initally assigned location of a new codespace.|
|idle_timeout_minutes|integer \| null|true|none|The number of minutes of inactivity after which this codespace will be automatically stopped.|
|web_url|string(uri)|true|none|URL to access this codespace on the web.|
|machines_url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL to access available alternate machine types for this codespace.|
|start_url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL to start this codespace.|
|stop_url|string(uri)|true|none|API URL to stop this codespace.|
|publish_url|string \| null(uri)|false|none|API URL to publish this codespace to a new repository.|
|pulls_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|API URL for the Pull Request associated with this codespace, if any.|
|recent_folders|[string]|true|none|none|
|runtime_constraints|object|false|none|none|
|pending_operation|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether or not a codespace has a pending async operation. This would mean that the codespace is temporarily unavailable. The only thing that you can do with a codespace in this state is delete it.|
|pending_operation_disabled_reason|string \| null|false|none|Text to show user when codespace is disabled by a pending operation|
|idle_timeout_notice|string \| null|false|none|Text to show user when codespace idle timeout minutes has been overriden by an organization policy|
|retention_period_minutes|integer \| null|false|none|Duration in minutes after codespace has gone idle in which it will be deleted. Must be integer minutes between 0 and 43200 (30 days).|
|retention_expires_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|When a codespace will be auto-deleted based on the "retention_period_minutes" and "last_used_at"|

The repository on GitHub where the event occurred. Webhook payloads contain the `repository` property
when the event occurs from activity in a repository.

The branch protection rule. Includes a `name` and all the [branch protection settings](https://docs.github.com/github/administering-a-repository/defining-the-mergeability-of-pull-requests/about-protected-branches#about-branch-protection-settings) applied to branches that match the name. Binary settings are boolean. Multi-level configurations are one of `off`, `non_admins`, or `everyone`. Actor and build lists are arrays of strings.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|admin_enforced|boolean|true|none|none|
|allow_deletions_enforcement_level|string|true|none|none|
|allow_force_pushes_enforcement_level|string|true|none|none|
|authorized_actor_names|[string]|true|none|none|
|authorized_actors_only|boolean|true|none|none|
|authorized_dismissal_actors_only|boolean|true|none|none|

Identifiers for a withdrawn Dependabot alert, captured before deletion so that
consumers can reconcile external records. This is not a full alert representation.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer(int64)|true|read-only|The unique identifier of the withdrawn alert.|
|node_id|string|true|read-only|The GraphQL node ID of the withdrawn alert.|
|number|[alert-number](#schemaalert-number)|true|read-only|The security alert number.|
|state|string|true|read-only|The state of the Dependabot alert.|
|dependency|object|true|read-only|Details for the vulnerable dependency.|
|security_advisory|object|true|read-only|Identifiers of the advisory that produced the withdrawn alert.|
|url|[alert-url](#schemaalert-url)|true|read-only|The REST API URL of the alert resource.|
|html_url|[alert-html-url](#schemaalert-html-url)|true|read-only|The GitHub URL of the alert resource.|
|created_at|[alert-created-at](#schemaalert-created-at)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was created in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.|
|withdrawn_at|string(date-time)|true|read-only|The time that the alert was withdrawn in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. This is not the advisory's withdrawal time.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|withdrawn|

Details of a Personal Access Token Request.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer|true|none|Unique identifier of the request for access via fine-grained personal access token. Used as the `pat_request_id` parameter in the list and review API calls.|
|owner|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
|permissions_added|object|true|none|New requested permissions, categorized by type of permission.|
|permissions_upgraded|object|true|none|Requested permissions that elevate access for a previously approved request for access, categorized by type of permission.|
|permissions_result|object|true|none|Permissions requested, categorized by type of permission. This field incorporates `permissions_added` and `permissions_upgraded`.|
|repository_selection|string|true|none|Type of repository selection requested.|
|repository_count|integer \| null|true|none|The number of repositories the token is requesting access to. This field is only populated when `repository_selection` is `subset`.|
|repositories|[object]|true|none|An array of repository objects the token is requesting access to. This field is only populated when `repository_selection` is `subset`.|
|created_at|string|true|none|Date and time when the request for access was created.|
|token_id|integer|true|none|Unique identifier of the user's token. This field can also be found in audit log events and the organization's settings for their PAT grants.|
|token_name|string|true|none|The name given to the user's token. This field can also be found in an organization's settings page for Active Tokens.|
|token_expired|boolean|true|none|Whether the associated fine-grained personal access token has expired.|
|token_expires_at|string \| null|true|none|Date and time when the associated fine-grained personal access token expires.|
|token_last_used_at|string \| null|true|none|Date and time when the associated fine-grained personal access token was last used for authentication.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|repository_selection|none|
|repository_selection|all|
|repository_selection|subset|

|use_squash_pr_title_as_default|boolean|false|none|Whether a squash merge commit can use the pull request title as default. **This property is closing down. Please use `squash_merge_commit_title` instead.**|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|action|string|true|none|none|
|changes|object|false|none|If the action was `edited`, the changes to the rule.|
|enterprise|[enterprise-webhooks](#schemaenterprise-webhooks)|false|none|An enterprise on GitHub. Webhook payloads contain the `enterprise` property when the webhook is configured<br>on an enterprise account or an organization that's part of an enterprise account. For more information,<br>see "[About enterprise accounts](https://docs.github.com/admin/overview/about-enterprise-accounts)."|
|installation|[simple-installation](#schemasimple-installation)|false|none|The GitHub App installation. Webhook payloads contain the `installation` property when the event is configured<br>for and sent to a GitHub App. For more information,<br>see "[Using webhooks with GitHub Apps](https://docs.github.com/apps/creating-github-apps/registering-a-github-app/using-webhooks-with-github-apps)."|
|organization|[organization-simple-webhooks](#schemaorganization-simple-webhooks)|false|none|A GitHub organization. Webhook payloads contain the `organization` property when the webhook is configured for an<br>organization, or when the event occurs from activity in a repository owned by an organization.|
|repository|[repository-webhooks](#schemarepository-webhooks)|true|none|The repository on GitHub where the event occurred. Webhook payloads contain the `repository` property<br>when the event occurs from activity in a repository.|
|rule|[webhooks_rule](#schemawebhooks_rule)|true|none|The branch protection rule. Includes a `name` and all the [branch protection settings](https://docs.github.com/github/administering-a-repository/defining-the-mergeability-of-pull-requests/about-protected-branches#about-branch-protection-settings) applied to branches that match the name. Binary settings are boolean. Multi-level configurations are one of `off`, `non_admins`, or `everyone`. Actor and build lists are arrays of strings.|
|sender|[simple-user](#schemasimple-user)|true|none|A GitHub user.|
